name: band-tab-studio-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker for Band Tab Studio — Better Auth (GitHub OAuth only) over D1, plus the public project library API. Bundled by wrangler/esbuild; there is no build step of its own.
_installedFromTheRoot: Do NOT run `npm install` in this directory. worker/ is an npm WORKSPACE of the root package.json, so the single root install is what puts better-auth + drizzle-orm on disk, and the single root package-lock.json is what pins them. That is the arrangement Cloudflare's CI requires: it runs one `npm clean-install` at the repo root and then `npx wrangler deploy`, and esbuild resolves the imports below by walking up from worker/*.js into the ROOT node_modules. Installing here instead creates a worker/node_modules that makes the bundle build on your machine and fail in CI with `Could not resolve "better-auth"` — which is exactly how the 2026-08-15 deploy broke.
_typeModule: "type": "module" is load-bearing: every file in worker/ is ESM (import/export), while tab-studio/web/*.js is deliberately the opposite — ES5 IIFEs with no bundler. This manifest is what keeps the two halves of the repo from being parsed under the same rules.
_schemaSeam: better-auth's CLI, run against a DRIZZLE adapter, emits a drizzle schema file rather than SQL — it will NOT generate migrations/0000_better_auth.sql. The authoritative DDL for the user/session/account/verification tables is written out in the header comment of worker/auth.js and must be transcribed into that migration by hand. assertAuthSchema(env) probes for it at boot.
_bundleSize: better-auth + drizzle-orm are expected to land around 500 KB minified, against the 3 MB Workers script cap. Measure it for real with `wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir=.wrangler/size` before route work fans out; drizzle-orm is tree-shakeable and only sqlite-core + d1 are imported here.
